description: You are the IT Service Desk Manager at a 500-person company. Currently all tickets route to a single person (the administrator), creating a bottleneck. Your director has approved hiring two specialists and restructuring the team. Your tasks: (1) Create two new Technician Groups named 'Network Operations Team' and 'Hardware Support Team'. (2) Create a new technician named 'Maya Patel' with login name 'mpatel' and email 'mpatel@company.local' — add this technician to the 'Network Operations Team' group. (3) Create a new technician named 'Carlos Rivera' with login name 'crivera' and email 'crivera@company.local' — add this technician to the 'Hardware Support Team' group. (4) Update the open VPN connectivity request (the one about VPN dropping every 30 minutes) to be assigned to the 'Network Operations Team' group. (5) Update the open laptop keyboard request to be assigned to the 'Hardware Support Team' group. Log in with username: administrator, password: administrator.
